verdict.rationale: llama.cpp documents its own 1.5- to 8-bit integer quantization, which covers INT4-class models in its native GGUF format. Community reports corroborate this, with Q6_K perplexity nearly matching FP16. However, nothing in the pack shows it loading FP8, GPTQ, or AWQ checkpoints, so it covers only part of the named formats. Missing for 10: evidence of FP8 support, evidence of loading GPTQ or AWQ formats, and documentation on importing or converting externally quantized checkpoints.
